bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health; appropriating money to the Family Tree Clinic.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; FAMILY TREE CLINIC.

$1,575,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $1,575,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for a grant to the Family Tree Clinic to provide health services, educational outreach, and workforce training for culturally competent care.
additions: $1,575,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $1,575,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for a grant to the Family Tree Clinic to provide health services, educational outreach, and workforce training for culturally competent care.
